name: Ginger-Steam Terraces
core_rationale: Tenth terracotta-and-mineral-spring terrace cluster of Hearthbloom Basin where Sola's geothermal vents simmer wild ginger roots and glazed ceramic steam-baths.
local_conflict: Effervescent ginger-steam sprites and glazed-clay bathhouse golems bubble out of the over-pressurized mineral cisterns.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Bathhouse keepers in Cinnamon-Bellows Sanctuary say the eastern mineral aqueducts carry warm ginger-scented steam from a hidden terrace of whistling teapot domes.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Stepped golden-ochre travertine pools and glazed ceramic steam-chimneys rising beyond the eastern ridge of Cinnamon-Bellows Bluff.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Which ancient Kiln-Master sealed the master pressure-valve beneath the Ginger-Steam Terraces?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-sola-hearth-weaver and scar-kiln-basin along the eastern geothermal rim of Continent 01.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Stepped golden-ochre travertine pools and whistling ceramic teapot bathhouses veiled in aromatic ginger steam.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m travertine walkways, 0.58m ceramic bath counters, and 0.14m pool step risers tailored to 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Draft status: seeds hunting-area-ginger-aqueduct-bridge at [0, 1] ahead of full 2x2 District promotion.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserves hunting-area-ginger-aqueduct-bridge in Mystery status with complete mystery_hook.
